effect:
Multi-hit moves hit more often.

Guarantees your multi-hit moves land 4 or 5 times instead of the normal 2-5. No more rolling a 2-hit Bullet Seed when you needed the kill.

Great on anything running Icicle Spear or that kind of thing. Skip it if you have Skill Link though - that would be pointless. For everyone else this takes multi-hit moves from inconsistent to reliable!
locations: Underground Path Switch Room Entrances · gift
